definitions.gloss: extreme; utterly (so ... that there is no limit)
definitions.explanation: Placed after a na-adjective stem or a noun of judgment, it says the quality goes to the very limit: {失礼|しつれい}{極|きわ}まりない (utterly rude), {危険|きけん}{極|きわ}まりない (extremely dangerous). It is a strong, rather formal expression, mostly used for negative qualities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧{極|きわ}まりない⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧だ。
examples.english: That is an utterly rude attitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧{極|きわ}まりない。
examples.english: A mountain road at night is extremely dangerous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{来|こ}ない→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{無責任|むせきにん}→無責任：13474_musekinin⟧{極|きわ}まりない⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧だ。
examples.english: Not turning up at the agreed time without a word is the height of irresponsibility.

notes:
Literally "having no limit", from {極|きわ}まる (to reach an extreme) + ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧. 〜{極|きわ}まる means the same and is equally common: ⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧{極|きわ}まる⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧{極|きわ}まりない: utterly rude
- ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧{極|きわ}まりない: extremely dangerous
- ⟦{不愉快|ふゆかい}→不愉快：11464_fuyukai⟧{極|きわ}まりない: thoroughly unpleasant
- ⟦{無責任|むせきにん}→無責任：13474_musekinin⟧{極|きわ}まりない: utterly irresponsible

WRITING:
Also written {極|きわ}まり{無|な}い or きわまりない; {窮|きわ}まりない is an older spelling.

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {極|きわ}まりなくなかったら
